name: Cormac Ulfhada
text: Cormac Ulfhada, also written Ulfhota, is a variant name of Cormac mac Airt. The Irish means long beard. See the article on Cormac mac Airt for the king's life and deeds.

attributes.attribute: variant name of Cormac mac Airt
